Connected MCPs are servers you chose to add, not Devin's built-in tools. You pay to list them in a session's context, and each time Devin calls one of their tools and reads the result.

No cost data for this period.

Always-on rules load in every session they apply to, such as a repo's root AGENTS.md in sessions using that repo, so you pay for them even when the task doesn't need them. Nested AGENTS.md files and rules with path patterns load only when a session touches a matching path.
If this share looks high, shorten your always-on rules and move guidance for one part of a repo into a nested AGENTS.md or a rule with a path pattern, so it loads only when needed.

Skills aren't always in context. Until a skill is used, a session carries at most its name and description, so you pay for its full instructions only in sessions that use it.
If this share looks high, check Customizations for your most-used skills, then shorten long ones or make their descriptions more specific so they load only when needed.
Share of this organization's cost over the last {{days}} days.

The cost of cloud compute depends on the machine your sessions run on and how long they run.
If the cloud compute share looks high, speed up slow builds and tests so sessions finish sooner, and choose a smaller machine when you don't need the capacity.
